7446707.name: Chabad of West Philadelphia
7446707.note: COLlive, 25 Aug 2026: 'Rabbi Mendel and Mushka Dubrowski will be moving on the Rebbe's Shlichus to start a New Chabad House in the community of West Philadelphia, PA.'

117957.name: Lubavitch of Center City
117957.note: Wikipedia (Historic Congregation B'nai Abraham, 523-527 Lombard Street, officially B'nai Abraham Chabad, home of Lubavitch of Center City): 'Rabbi Yochonon Goldman became the congregation's rabbi in 2000'. COLlive, 9 April 2024: Rabbi Yochonon and Leah Goldman 'have been leading the community over the past 24 years', which agrees; the Jewish Exponent (search snippet) dates their appointment as emissaries to Philadelphia to January 2000. The congregation itself is much older; the year is when Chabad's leadership began. Leah Goldman founded the Center City Jewish Preschool in 2001.

118473.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Lehigh Valley
118473.note: Its own Idealist profile: Rabbi Yaakov and Devorah Halperin 'established Chabad Lubavitch of the Lehigh Valley in Allentown, Pennsylvania in 2001'. It first met in their home; a new center was dedicated in 2009 (search summaries).

118495.name: Chabad of Penn State
118495.note: Penn State News, 28 Oct 2019: the Meretskys 'will celebrate 18 years on campus'; Rabbi Nosson Meretsky: 'We first arrived on the Penn State campus on 11 September 2001'. CrownHeights.info (Daily Collegian Q&A), 2 Dec 2012: 'We've been here 11 years. This will be our 12th annual menorah lighting', which agrees.

118357.name: Chabad of the Main Line
118357.note: Its own Idealist profile: 'Opened in 1999, Chabad of the Main Line', now 'at the historic General Wayne Inn' in Merion Station (Rabbi Shraga Sherman). It began in a storefront on Montgomery Avenue (and was in Bala Cynwyd in 2005); the General Wayne Inn center opened 31 Jan 2007 (Jewish Exponent via CrownHeights.info).

earlier.where: Storefront on Montgomery Avenue; Bala Cynwyd (2005)

118619.name: Chabad Lubavitch of The Poconos
118619.note: Chabad.org, 9 Nov 2007 ('Mountain Region Chabad House Symbol of Exurbs' Growth Nationwide'): 'Rabbi Mendel Bendet, the young co-director of the four-year-old Chabad-Lubavitch of the Poconos' (so about 2003). One count-back; therebbesimpact.com also has the Bendets 2003 (a lead).

319750.name: Rohr Chabad Jewish Center
319750.note: LancasterOnline (CrownHeights.info, 14 July 2013): 'Green, a Pittsburgh native, came to Lancaster in 2003, when Rabbi Shaya Sackett, of Congregation Degel Israel, invited him to teach Hebrew half time ... Green devoted the other half of his workday to establishing a local branch of Chabad'; the Chabad Jewish Enrichment Center first shared the Greens' home on Race Avenue, and the Rohr center at 1024 Harrisburg Pike opened in 2013. York Daily Record (Oct 2007): they 'moved to Lancaster three years ago and started the Chabad Jewish Enrichment Center' (about 2004). IRS: Chabad of Lancaster Inc, ruling July 2005.

earlier.where: The Greens' home on Race Avenue, Lancaster

562076.name: Chabad of York, PA
562076.note: York Daily Record (CrownHeights.info, 18 Oct 2007), 'Chabad to Open Jewish Outreach Center': Rabbi Elazar Green's Chabad Jewish Enrichment Center of Lancaster & York 'has purchased a house in Spring Garden Township near York College' that 'will become York County's first Chabad House'; he had looked for a house in York for three years. The chabad.org listing (562076) is from about 2007, which agrees.

118217.name: Lubavitch of Montgomery County
118217.note: CrownHeights.info, 4 July 2007: 'Lubavitch of Montgomery County has operated for 10 years now, but programs have taken place all over' (Rabbi Shaya and Devorah Leah Deitsch; so about 1997). IRS: Lubavitch Of Montgomery County, ruling Oct 2000, which allows it. One count-back only.

118280.name: Chabad of Chester County & Western Main Line
118280.note: IRS: Chabad Lubavitch Of Chester County & Western Mainline, ruling April 2001, so it existed by then. PA Senate (2023): Rabbi Yossi and Tickey Kaplan 'came to Chester County about twenty years ago ... to start a Chabad Center' (approximate). Jewish Exponent (2006): ark dedication. Start year not stated.

118420.name: Chabad of the Abingtons - Jewish Discovery Center
118420.note: COLlive, 11 April 2021: Rabbi Benny and Chany Rapoport, shluchim to Clarks Summit and the Abingtons, 'have been serving the local Jewish community since arriving in 2001'. A chabad.org profile (search summary, not checked) says fall 2000. IRS: Chabad Of The Abingtons Inc, ruling May 2002. The Jewish Discovery Center at 749 Northern Blvd opened in 2003; now 216 Miller Road, Waverly. The two sources differ by a year: medium.

118237.name: Chabad-Lubavitch of Berks County
118237.note: Reading Eagle (CrownHeights.info, 15 Feb 2009): Congregation Shomrei Habrith, 2310 Hampden Blvd, became the Chabad Center; 'Rabbi Yosef Lipsker, who has been the congregation's rabbi since 1997, will stay on as Chabad rabbi'. IRS: Chabad Lubavitch Of Berks County Inc, ruling Jan 2008. When Chabad of Berks County itself began (1997 or later) is not stated.

117713.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Harrisburg
117713.note: IRS: Chabad-Lubavitch Congregation Of Harrisburg (3515 Green St), ruling May 1993, so it existed by then. Encyclopaedia Judaica lists 'Machzike Hadas (1904), now known as Chabad-Lubavitch' among Harrisburg's congregations. Rabbi Shmuel Pewzner's start is not found.

117880.name: Lubavitch of Bucks County
117880.note: Philadelphia Inquirer (CrownHeights.info, 6 Oct 2005): the $1.5 million Glazier Center in a former Baptist church in Newtown Borough, Rabbi Yehuda Shemtov executive director; so it existed by 2005. Lubavitch.com (undated): an awards dinner marked 'thirteen years of Lubavitch Chabad in Bucks County'. Start year not found.

2761055.name: Chabad of North Pocono
2761055.note: IRS: Chabad Of North Pocono (947 Clay Ave, Scranton), ruling March 2020, so it existed by then. Mitzvah Mobile; Rabbi Mendel Raices. Lead: therebbesimpact.com has Mendel & Chaya Raices 2011; the chabad.org listing (2761055) is from about 2014.

117945.name: Chabad House @ University of Pennsylvania
117945.note: The Lubavitch House at Penn (4032-34 Spruce Street, now the Perelman Center for Jewish Life): the Daily Pennsylvanian (June 2016) says it 'opened in 1980 to serve as the University's Chabad house'; JNS's author note: Rabbi Menachem Schmidt 'established the Lubavitch House at the University of Pennsylvania in 1980'; Schmidt: when they launched it in 1980 there were eight full-time campus Chabad Houses in America. (One source says 1979.) Rabbi Ephraim Levin is listed for it today.

744158.name: Chabad at Lehigh University
744158.note: The Brown and White (Lehigh), 19 Oct 2016: 'Zalman Greenberg decided to create Chabad at Lehigh in 2008'; another Brown and White profile: in July 2008 Dit and Zalman Greenberg moved to Bethlehem. The former Kulik Funeral Home became its center (Joachim Schaufeld Center for Jewish Life) in 2016.

1337772.name: Chabad Serving Drexel University - Rohr Jewish Student Center
1337772.note: CrownHeights.info and COLlive, 14 Nov 2010, 'New Shluchim to Drexel University': Rabbi Chaim and Moussia Goldstein; they first gave Torah classes and a few months later moved to Philadelphia to establish a permanent Chabad presence at Drexel. The chabad.org listing (1337772) is from Nov 2010, which agrees.

420369.name: Rohr Center for Jewish Life - Chabad House
420369.note: Times of Israel blog (Allan Ripp, 7 Oct 2025): Rabbi Eli Gurevitz 'first arrived at the Quaker-founded school in 2006'; 'When my wife and I first arrived in 2006', perhaps among the first full-time Chabad operations at a small liberal-arts college; an alumnus urged him to 'pack it in after 17 years' (about 2023). Serves Haverford, Bryn Mawr and Swarthmore. The chabad.org listing (420369) is from about 2006, which agrees.

484384.name: The Stanley Middleman Center for Jewish Life - Rohr Chabad @ Temple University
484384.note: Its own campaign 'Jewish Owls Turn 10!': 'the Kantor Family joined the Temple University Family the 2007-2008 school year'; '10 YEARS HAVE GONE BY!!!'. Rabbi Baruch S. Kantor, 1428 N Broad Street.

4809936.name: Old City Jewish Arts Center
4809936.note: Old City District listing: 'Founded in 2006, the OCJAC was envisioned as a platform to build Jewish community through the arts.' CrownHeights.info, 18 Dec 2013: Rabbi Menachem Schmidt 'started the Old City Jewish Art Center ... about seven years ago', which agrees. Co-director today Rabbi Zalman Shimon Wircberg.

6670209.name: Chabad of Media
6670209.note: CrownHeights.info, 19 March 2025: 'Rabbi Avraham and Chanie Deitsch have moved to Media, Pennsylvania to launch a new Chabad center in the city - and the fourth in the county'.

2752570.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Northern Delaware County
2752570.note: CrownHeights.info, 19 March 2025: Rabbi Tzvi and Rikki Altein 'who've been serving Chabad of Delaware County, Pennsylvania for the past decade' (so about 2015). The chabad.org listing (2752570) is from about 2014-15. One count-back only.

5386600.name: Chabad West Shore Jewish Center
5386600.note: COLlive, 10 Aug 2022: 'Rabbi Nissen and Chana Pewzner (Kosofsky) and their baby ... moved on Shlichus to Cumberland County, PA ... The Pewzners will be establishing the Chabad west shore Jewish Center'.

6021390.name: Swarthmore Chabad
6021390.note: COLlive, 30 July 2023: 'Rabbi Mordi and Reizel Wolf (nee Garelik) are the new Shluchim to Swarthmore College'; Tri-Co Chabad (Rabbi Eli and Blumie Gurevitz) 'entrusted Swarthmore College to the Wolfs to branch out and establish an independent Chabad House'.
